# DesignQit — Qomardeen Tijani

> Portfolio of Qomardeen Tijani, a Product Designer working at the intersection of UX, AI, and systems thinking. Case studies, essays, and contact.

Qomardeen Tijani is a Product Designer focused on building scalable, user-centered digital products — fintech, SaaS dashboards, and AI-native tools. This site collects shipped case studies, written essays on design and AI, and the entry points for hiring or collaboration.

## Pages

- [Home](/en): Overview of work, profile, and featured projects.
- [About](/en/about): Background, education, and design philosophy.
- [Projects](/en/projects): Case studies of shipped product work.
- [Architecture](/en/architecture): How systems are designed beyond the interface.
- [Hire](/en/hire): Availability, process, and booking.
- [Contact](/en/contact): Direct contact channels.

## Blog

- [Blog index](/en/blog): All published articles.
- [The Designer Who Ships](/en/article/the-designer-who-ships): How AI changes the product-design job and what staying valuable looks like.

## Thinking

- [Thinking index](/en/thinking): Essays on design process, systems, and craft.

## Optional
